x: In the Long Jump we were without the services of Skelley and Wiley last season. Charlie Jones, whilst not doing anything outstanding, managed to gain 2nd or third place in most of the matches.
It is believed that Skelley, who until he had a motor-cycle accident in 1939 had shown 22 feet in the Long Jump once or twice, hopes to be able to turn out again when his Forces duties permit.
Luxon was putting up a new best championship performance in the long jump with a leap of 23ft. 1in, beating Skelley's old standing record of 1938.

…nental coach, Herr Franz Stampfl, whose vivacious enthusiasm and expert knowledge soon endeared him to our members .... Skelley & Melchoir (field events) accomplished performances late in the season which two months earlier had seemed almost impossible.…
